environment.processorType: Snapdragon(R) X Elite - X1E80100 - Qualcomm(R) Oryon(TM) CPU

method: One warm editor process; one sample per size and condition, closed condition first.
Same staged dataset, loaded objects and per-call SetLabels workload; closed control has no DataVisualizer window but project import hooks remain active.
Yield and persist progress every sixteen label writes; check resources before each write.
Open-window workload follows rename, label filtering, Undo/Redo, move and missing-script recovery checks.
After real writes, explicitly invoke production OnPostprocessAllAssets with duplicate paths, then wait for the queue and index to settle.
Callback timing measures the explicit replay only. Processed counts include real notifications, work between yields and the explicit replay; they are not unique asset counts.
The settle observer includes a 150 ms confirmation delay and editor scheduling. Reconciliation is wall time, not CPU time.
checks: Missing selected script retains saved identity and recovers inspector selection.
Cached rename loads zero objects; label include/exclude, Undo/Redo and move reconcile.
Routine operations and both label/replay samples preserve row/search generation; an intentional later search rebuild advances only search generation.
Unavailable asset deletion clears canonical order, saved order and saved selection during an explicit search rebuild.
Closed-window rename/reopen preserves custom order and selection; disposed owner rejects stale GUID work.
Simulated Play notifications suspend/resume reconciliation and preserve order and selection.
limitations: Single samples do not establish medians, p95, speedup, or worst-case guarantees.
Sequential per-asset label writes plus a duplicate-path replay are not a single atomic bulk import.
The measured SetLabels call includes synchronous project hooks; the control does not isolate Unity-only or package-absent cost.
Closed/open conditions are ordered and have different labels, cache history and prior interaction history.
Replay callback is synchronous and measured 77.690 ms at 2000 paths; this is not a cooperative-callback guarantee.
The memory guard sums overlapping counters and is not RSS.
Actual Play Mode transitions, fresh processes, Unity 2021.3, other platforms, 10k bursts and 100k assets remain unverified here.
